sapientinc/PRAXIST.what: PRAXIST 是一個自主研究系統，針對目標可量測、可由電腦執行的研究任務。它會協調多個平行的研究 agent，配合任務歸屬的評估、可保存的實驗證據，以及跨世代的結果綜合，把研究當成持續運行的流程而非一連串獨立的 prompt。適用情境是專案已經在跑、目標可量測，但最佳改進路徑未知的時候。
sapientinc/PRAXIST.what_en: PRAXIST is an autonomous research system for objectives that are measurable and executable by computer. It coordinates parallel research agents with task-owned evaluation, durable evidence, and generation-to-generation synthesis, treating research as a persistent process rather than a series of disconnected prompts. It targets projects that are already running with a measurable objective where the best path forward is unknown.
sapientinc/PRAXIST.verdict: Sapient（HRM 那家）的新作，組織有既有聲量，加上「autonomous research agent」正是當紅題材，3 天 4400 星的速度是實質內容＋品牌動能疊加的結果。注意授權是 Fair Source 不是 OSI 開源。

HEJustinSun/my-girlfriend-jingtian-latex.what: 一個 XeLaTeX 排版工程，內容是題為「我的女友景甜」的 5×8 英寸書籍。編譯需要 XeLaTeX 與標準 TeX Live 發行版。
HEJustinSun/my-girlfriend-jingtian-latex.what_en: A XeLaTeX typesetting project for a 5×8-inch book titled "My Girlfriend Jing Tian." Building it requires XeLaTeX and a standard TeX Live distribution.
HEJustinSun/my-girlfriend-jingtian-latex.verdict: 典型獵奇整活：帳號 5 天新、只有這一個 repo，卻靠中文網路的梗傳播衝出 3000+ followers 和 4000+ 星。內容本身就是個玩笑排版工程，星數反映的是傳播力不是技術。

b-nnett/grok-bot-0.18-reconstructed.what: 這是 Grok Bot 0.18.0 macOS 桌面應用的非官方原始碼向重建，把該應用的 Electron、host、coordinator、本地執行、協定與 renderer 各層還原成可讀的 TypeScript 實作，並提供能把這些原始碼重新打包回可運作 macOS 應用的確定性工具鏈。另外加了幾項實驗功能：跨 Cursor、Claude Code、Codex、OpenRouter 的推理路由、跨供應商的 plugin/MCP 工具，以及本地用量追蹤。
b-nnett/grok-bot-0.18-reconstructed.what_en: An unofficial, source-oriented reconstruction of the Grok Bot 0.18.0 macOS desktop app. It provides readable TypeScript implementations of the app's Electron, host, coordinator, local-execution, protocol, and renderer layers, plus a deterministic toolchain to rebuild those sources into a working macOS application. It also adds experiments such as an inference router across Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, and OpenRouter, cross-provider plugin/MCP tools, and local usage tracking.
b-nnett/grok-bot-0.18-reconstructed.verdict: 逆向重建知名閉源 app 這個類型本身就自帶話題（同款套路先前在其他 AI 助手 app 上也紅過），但工程量是真的，帳號也是 2020 年的老號。靠 Grok 名字吸睛、靠內容留人。沒掛 license，對「重建」性質的專案來說是個隱患。

tobi/walgit.what: walgit 是一個單一 binary 的 git server，直接架在 S3 或 GCS 之類的物件儲存前面，沒有資料庫、沒有 leader、機器上沒有需要在意的本地狀態。它提供 smart HTTP 的 fetch/push、以靜態檔案伺服的 bundle-uri clone、Git LFS、瀏覽用 web UI、含 SDK 的 JSON API、per-repo push policy 與 webhook。每台跑 walgit 的機器都只是可拋棄的快取，bucket 本身就是 repository，多台機器指向同一個 bucket 即可一致地服務相同的 repo。
tobi/walgit.what_en: walgit is a git server shipped as a single binary that sits in front of an object store such as S3 or GCS — no database, no leader, no local state that matters. It serves smart HTTP fetch and push, bundle-uri clones as static files, Git LFS, a browsing web UI, a JSON API with an SDK, per-repository push policies, and webhooks. Each machine running walgit is a disposable cache; the bucket is the repository, and adding machines pointed at the same bucket scales it out consistently.
tobi/walgit.verdict: 作者是 Shopify CEO Tobi Lütke，光這個署名就保證上榜。專案本身的架構主張（bucket 即 repo、無狀態 server）確實有意思也有實作，但星數增速主要還是名人效應驅動。

XiaoDuoYa/codex-with-chatgpt.what: 這個專案把付費訂閱的 ChatGPT 網頁版接進 Codex 編碼會話，讓 ChatGPT 負責規劃與 review、Codex 保留全部執行權，藉此用閒置的網頁版額度取代規劃工作消耗的 API 額度。不需要 API key 也不走逆向代理：ChatGPT 透過一條 OAuth 保護的唯讀 MCP 連線，按需讀取目前工作區中需要的程式碼，repo 本身不會被上傳。
XiaoDuoYa/codex-with-chatgpt.what_en: This project wires the ChatGPT web app (the subscription you already pay for) into Codex coding sessions as the planning and review brain, while Codex keeps full execution authority — shifting planning work from metered API tokens to idle web-quota. No API keys and no reverse proxy: ChatGPT reads only the code it needs from the current workspace over an OAuth-protected, read-only MCP connection, and the repository is never uploaded.
XiaoDuoYa/codex-with-chatgpt.verdict: 打中「訂閱額度閒置、API 額度肉痛」這個真實痛點，中英雙語 README 明顯瞄準中文開發者社群，2 天 1200 星大概率是從那邊引爆的。作者只有 11 個 followers，星數是題目選得準，不是帳號帶的。額度套利類工具，實用但壽命取決於 OpenAI 的容忍度。

wide-trace/open-higgsfield.what: OpenHiggsfield 自稱是 Higgsfield AI 的開源替代品：一個圖片與影片生成工作室，透過單一 prompt 欄呼叫 40 個模型（12 個圖片、28 個影片），各模型有自己的設定，所有生成結果收在同一個 gallery。另提供免安裝的托管版本，需填入自己的平台金鑰（id:secret）才能開始生成。
wide-trace/open-higgsfield.what_en: OpenHiggsfield describes itself as an open-source alternative to Higgsfield AI: an image and video generation studio with a single prompt bar covering 40 models (12 image, 28 video), per-model settings, and a unified gallery of finished runs. A hosted version is offered that requires no install; you supply your own platform key (id:secret) to start generating.
wide-trace/open-higgsfield.verdict: 警訊齊全：帳號 4 天新、4 個 followers、唯一 repo、沒 license，名字直接蹭 Higgsfield，主打把人導去托管站並要求填入金鑰。「open source alternative to X」是近期星數操作的常見模板，這個組合高度可疑，別碰托管版。

bryllim/workout-guide.what: 一個開放的健身動作插圖庫，收錄 302 個動作、每個動作三張風格一致的分解圖，並提供帶型別、框架中立的 npm 套件與可搜尋的靜態圖庫網站。原始姿勢插畫來自 Everkinetic（CC BY-SA 4.0），作者在其基礎上擴充了動作與動畫幀、統一素材規格並補上結構化 metadata 與套件 API。
bryllim/workout-guide.what_en: An open exercise illustration library with 302 exercises, three consistent frames per exercise, a typed framework-neutral npm package, and a searchable static gallery. The original pose artwork comes from Everkinetic under CC BY-SA 4.0; the author added more exercises and animation frames, normalized the assets, and built structured metadata, package APIs, and the documentation gallery.
bryllim/workout-guide.verdict: 健身 app 開發者長期缺乏可商用的動作插圖，這個庫直接填了缺口，授權和素材來源也交代得清楚。是那種「早該有人做」的實用資源，上榜合理。

MetaMask-AI/metamask-desktop.what: 自稱是 MetaMask 的跨平台桌面應用，供 Windows、macOS、Linux 管理加密貨幣錢包、連接 Web3 應用與 DeFi/NFT 生態。README 自己聲明與 MetaMask 或 ConsenSys 無關聯、非官方背書。
MetaMask-AI/metamask-desktop.what_en: Claims to be a cross-platform MetaMask desktop application for Windows, macOS, and Linux, for managing a cryptocurrency wallet and connecting to Web3 applications and DeFi/NFT ecosystems. Its own README states it is not affiliated with or endorsed by MetaMask or ConsenSys.
MetaMask-AI/metamask-desktop.verdict: 教科書級冒名：帳號名直接叫 MetaMask-AI、44 天新號、0 followers、唯一 repo、沒 license，README 還殘留 ChatGPT 生成痕跡（:contentReference[oaicite:0]）。錢包類冒名專案幾乎必然是釣資產的，2 天 997 星大概率也是刷的。

Tencent/WeMM-Embedding.what: WeMM-Embedding 是騰訊微信視覺團隊開發的通用多模態 embedding 模型家族，為文字、圖片、影片、視覺文件與交錯多模態輸入提供統一表徵。提供 2B、4B、9B 三個尺寸，皆支援 Matryoshka 多維度輸出（64 到 4096 維），模型權重已上架 Hugging Face。
Tencent/WeMM-Embedding.what_en: WeMM-Embedding is a family of universal multimodal embedding models from the WeChat Vision team at Tencent, providing unified representations for text, images, videos, visual documents, and interleaved multimodal inputs. It ships in 2B, 4B, and 9B sizes, all supporting Matryoshka output dimensions from 64 up to 4096, with weights available on Hugging Face.
Tencent/WeMM-Embedding.verdict: 大廠官方模型發布的標準上榜路徑：Tencent 組織帳號自帶分發管道，多模態 embedding 也是 RAG 基建的剛需。內容是實的，星數有大廠光環加成。

themartiano/try-omarchy.what: Try Omarchy 把上游 Omarchy 桌面環境打包成 Apple Silicon Mac 上免設定即可執行的原生應用：內含專案自建的 ARM64 Arch Linux 映像（預裝 Omarchy）、使用 Apple Hypervisor Framework 的 QEMU runtime，以及一個 Swift/AppKit 啟動器。映像由 pin 定版本的 Arch Linux ARM 套件與上游 Omarchy 原始碼建出，支援硬體加速虛擬化與 VirGL 圖形。專案聲明非官方、與 Omarchy 無關聯。
themartiano/try-omarchy.what_en: Try Omarchy packages the upstream Omarchy desktop as a native app for Apple Silicon Macs with zero setup: a project-built ARM64 Arch Linux image preconfigured with Omarchy, a QEMU runtime on Apple's Hypervisor Framework, and a small Swift/AppKit launcher, all in one macOS app. The image is built from pinned Arch Linux ARM packages and a pinned revision of the upstream Omarchy source, with hardware-accelerated virtualization and VirGL graphics. It is unofficial and not affiliated with Omarchy.
themartiano/try-omarchy.verdict: 搭上 Omarchy 熱潮的順風車——「Mac 使用者想嚐鮮但不想裝 Arch」這個需求真實存在，打包工程（pin 版映像、Hypervisor 加速、原生啟動器）也做得扎實。星數動能來自 Omarchy 的熱度外溢，但東西本身是真的。

fuxicodex/Fuxi.what: FuXi 是一個在終端機裡運行的 AI coding agent，以 Go 撰寫並打包成單一靜態執行檔，不需額外的 runtime 依賴。它提供讀寫程式碼、執行指令、驅動工具的 TUI 介面，支援任何 OpenAI 相容模型，並具備跨 LLM 供應商的成本感知路由與自動容錯移轉。README 將其定位為供應商中立的 Claude Code 替代品，同時是 MCP client 並支援自我更新。
fuxicodex/Fuxi.what_en: FuXi is a terminal-based AI coding agent written in Go and shipped as a single static binary with no runtime dependencies. It reads and edits code, runs commands, and drives tools from a TUI, working with any OpenAI-compatible model via cost-aware routing and automatic failover across LLM providers. The README positions it as a provider-agnostic alternative to Claude Code, with MCP client support and self-updating.
fuxicodex/Fuxi.verdict: 帳號才 79 天、名下只有這一個 repo，26 天衝到近三千星、日均 113 星，行銷味不輕；但產品本身有官網、有完整功能面，內容是實的。定位打「provider-agnostic 的 Claude Code 替代品」正中目前 BYOK 終端 agent 的需求缺口，上榜合理，唯星數成長曲線值得持續觀察是否有灌水。

zouyuxuan122/Deepseek-Harness-EAC.what: 把官方 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）封裝成開箱即用的 Windows 桌面客戶端，內建 Node.js 運行環境與完整 dsh CLI，提供安裝版與便攜版，雙擊即可啟動。在此之上整合社群生態：內建 10 款介面主題，並支援插件一鍵安裝、安裝前自動快照、異常時的修復與回滾。
zouyuxuan122/Deepseek-Harness-EAC.what_en: A ready-to-run Windows desktop client that wraps the official DeepSeek Harness (dsh), bundling a Node.js runtime and the full dsh CLI so it launches with a double click, in both installer and portable editions. On top of that it layers community ecosystem features: ten built-in UI themes, one-click plugin installation, automatic snapshots before installs, and repair/rollback when a plugin misbehaves.
zouyuxuan122/Deepseek-Harness-EAC.verdict: 本週榜上至少四個「dsh 桌面殼」高度雷同專案之一（另有 vibeinging/dsh-desktop、myYangyunfan/dsh_desktop、fufankeji/deepseek-harness-studio），全是同一波 DeepSeek Harness 熱潮下的包殼競賽。這個是其中星數最高的，功能差異化在快照回滾，但本質仍是官方 CLI 的桌面包裝。

SaladDay/pi-from-scratch.what: 用約 600 行 TypeScript 從零實作一個能讀檔案、改程式碼、執行指令的迷你版 pi coding agent，作為教學文章發佈。配套網站將文章與原始碼並排呈現，閱讀進度推進時右側編輯器會逐步補全程式碼，並提供可逐行打斷點的 Trace 追蹤來理解執行流程。實際運行 nano-pi 需要 Node.js 22 以上與一個 OpenAI 相容 API。
SaladDay/pi-from-scratch.what_en: A tutorial that builds a minimal version of the pi coding agent from scratch in roughly 600 lines of TypeScript — an agent that can read files, edit code, and run commands. The companion website presents the article and source side by side: as you read, the editor pane fills in the code step by step, and a trace view lets you step through execution line by line. Running the resulting nano-pi requires Node.js 22+ and any OpenAI-compatible API.
SaladDay/pi-from-scratch.verdict: 「從零手寫 agent」的教學題材一直有穩定需求，這個的亮點是閱讀進度驅動程式碼補全＋Trace 逐行追蹤的網站形式，教學工程做得比一般 from-scratch 文章用心。作者是五年老帳號，內容真材實料，上榜是品質帶動。

Tiger3807861189/DeepSeek-V4-J-Space-Capa.what: 一份評測報告，宣稱在相同模型、環境與採樣條件下，比較 DeepSeek V4 Flash Vision Exp 接入與不接入「J-Space Cognition Suite V3.7」的表現差異。報告在 Terminal-Bench、DeepSWE、GAIA、HLE 等基準的子集上列出準確率與牆鐘時間的對照數字，並與 GLM 5.3、Kimi K3、Opus 4.8、Fable 5 等模型並列。倉庫本身只有報告內容，不含可執行程式碼。
Tiger3807861189/DeepSeek-V4-J-Space-Capa.what_en: A benchmark report claiming to compare DeepSeek V4 Flash Vision Exp with and without the author's "J-Space Cognition Suite V3.7" attached, under identical model, environment, and sampling conditions. It tabulates accuracy and wall-clock numbers on subsets of Terminal-Bench, DeepSWE, GAIA, and HLE, placed alongside figures for GLM 5.3, Kimi K3, Opus 4.8, and Fable 5. The repository contains only the report itself, with no runnable code.
Tiger3807861189/DeepSeek-V4-J-Space-Capa.verdict: 41 天新帳號、無程式碼、拿自家「J-Space 套件」對著 DeepSeek V4 出對照數字，主表增益多在誤差範圍內（HLE 37.8→37.8），「理論上均可復現」但不給復現材料——典型蹭 DeepSeek 熱度替自家套件導流的偽 benchmark 報告，14 天破千星的成長更可疑。

Zyrexnn/Cybermes.what: 面向授權滲透測試與 bug bounty 的攻擊性資安自動化框架，基於 Hermes Agent 與多模型 LLM 協作。內含 200 多個模組化攻擊性資安 playbook、Go 撰寫的效能工具與 token 優化的串流管線，涵蓋偵察、漏洞研究到結構化報告的流程。可透過 MCP 接入 AI 編碼環境使用，也可作為獨立 CLI 執行。
Zyrexnn/Cybermes.what_en: An offensive-security automation framework for authorized bug bounty hunting and red teaming, built on Hermes Agent with multi-model LLM orchestration. It ships 200+ modular offensive-security playbooks, native Go performance utilities, and token-optimized streaming pipelines covering reconnaissance, vulnerability research, and structured reporting. It can plug into AI coding environments via MCP or run as a standalone CLI.
Zyrexnn/Cybermes.verdict: 資安 × agent 是今年的交叉熱點，這類「自動化打洞框架」自帶話題性。作者是兩年老帳號、51 個 repo，內容看起來有實作而非空殼；11 天 665 星的速度部分靠題材敏感度加成，但底子是實的。

vibeinging/dsh-desktop.what: 社群維護的 DeepSeek Harness 桌面發行版，直接運行官方 dsh npm 運行時與官方 dsh web app，並預裝一組經過固定和驗證的社群插件 Bundle。對話、檔案、Git、終端、任務、Worktree 與插件市場都運行在同一個 dsh Profile 中，免除自行搭建環境與管理插件狀態的步驟。提供經 Apple 公證的 macOS 安裝包與 Windows 安裝器。
vibeinging/dsh-desktop.what_en: A community-maintained desktop distribution of DeepSeek Harness that runs the official dsh npm runtime and web app directly, preloaded with a pinned, verified bundle of community plugins. Chat, files, Git, terminal, tasks, worktrees, and the plugin marketplace all operate within a single dsh profile, removing the need to set up an environment or manage plugin state yourself. It ships a notarized macOS installer and a Windows installer.
vibeinging/dsh-desktop.verdict: 同一波 dsh 桌面包殼潮的其中一席，與 EAC、dsh_desktop、harness-studio 同期高度雷同。差異化是「跑官方 web app＋固定驗證過的插件組合」路線，工程上比較保守穩健，但上榜主要還是搭上熱潮。

myYangyunfan/dsh_desktop.what: DeepSeek Harness 的 Windows／macOS 桌面客戶端，內建獨立 Node.js 運行時、npm CLI、完整 dsh 與全部官方插件，免安裝環境、雙擊即用，提供便攜版與安裝版。v0.5.0 起桌面殼從 Electron 遷移至 Tauri 2（Rust），並加入系統托盤、會話管理、餘額小部件、桌面寵物等介面功能。
myYangyunfan/dsh_desktop.what_en: A Windows/macOS desktop client for DeepSeek Harness that bundles a standalone Node.js runtime, npm CLI, the full dsh package, and all official plugins — no environment setup, double-click to launch, in both portable and installer editions. Since v0.5.0 the shell has migrated from Electron to Tauri 2 (Rust), adding a system tray, session management, a balance widget, and a desktop pet.
myYangyunfan/dsh_desktop.verdict: dsh 桌面殼大隊的又一席。帳號 106 天、0 follower，17 天 610 星，成長與帳號體量不成比例；Electron 遷 Tauri 算有做事，但與同期三、四個雷同專案擠在一起，明顯是熱潮產物。

jundizhou/easy-stock.what: 面向個人投資者的 A 股行情分析與 AI 投研桌面應用，以 Go 撰寫、本地優先。聚合開盤啦、東方財富、新浪、財聯社等來源的行情、K 線、題材與資訊數據，將趨勢、題材、連板、情緒、量價整理成可計算的領域模型，並透過定時調度與 Agent 自動抓取文章、去重、歸檔並提煉觀點。支援大 V 自動復盤、個股 AI 分析、持倉 AI 巡檢與本地研究記憶。
jundizhou/easy-stock.what_en: A local-first desktop app for A-share (Chinese stock market) analysis and AI-assisted research, written in Go and aimed at individual investors. It aggregates quotes, candlestick data, sector themes, and news from sources like Kaipanla, Eastmoney, Sina, and Cailianshe, models trends, themes, limit-up chains, sentiment, and volume-price structure as computable domain objects, and uses scheduled agents to fetch, deduplicate, archive, and summarize articles. Features include automated KOL review digests, per-stock AI analysis, portfolio AI inspection, and persistent local research memory.
jundizhou/easy-stock.verdict: A 股散戶工具在中文 GitHub 圈有穩定基本盤，「AI 原生投研」的切入點比傳統行情軟體加聊天框更完整。作者近五年老帳號，功能面做得厚，是題材加持下的實質專案。

fufankeji/deepseek-harness-studio.what: DeepSeek Harness 的零代碼桌面增強工具，支援 Windows 與 macOS，一鍵啟動。核心功能包括插件的自動發現與推送、AI 推薦、免命令行的搜尋／校驗／安裝／啟停／卸載，以及安裝前風險檢查與失敗自動回滾；另有 Workspace 會話管理、長會話目錄跳轉、Preset 廣場與七套內置工作流。
fufankeji/deepseek-harness-studio.what_en: A zero-code desktop companion for DeepSeek Harness on Windows and macOS with one-click launch. Its core features are plugin discovery and recommendation — searching, validating, installing, toggling, and uninstalling plugins without a command line, with pre-install risk checks and automatic rollback on failure — plus workspace-based session management, long-conversation navigation, a preset gallery, and seven built-in workflows.
fufankeji/deepseek-harness-studio.verdict: 還是 dsh 桌面殼那一批，不過這家是「赋范空间」（有既有受眾的教育品牌，546 follower），差異化押在插件市場與 AI 推薦上。品牌自帶流量＋熱潮加成，歸類上仍是同期雷同專案洪流的一員。

HanyuanWang/LiveStream-Agent-Studio.what: 面向抖音直播電商團隊的 Windows 本地優先 AI Agent 工作台，把主播發現、直播拆解、話術與流量復盤、短視頻內容編導整合到統一入口。目標使用者是直播運營、投放、內容與復盤團隊，將榜單與錄像等素材轉為結構化的洞察與企劃產出。README 提醒先以非敏感素材驗證環境、帳號權限與輸出品質後再投入正式業務。
HanyuanWang/LiveStream-Agent-Studio.what_en: A local-first Windows AI agent workspace for Douyin (TikTok China) livestream commerce teams, unifying creator discovery, livestream breakdown, script and traffic performance review, and short-form video planning in a single interface. It targets livestream operations, ad, content, and review teams, turning leaderboards and recordings into structured insights and plans. The README advises validating the environment, account permissions, and output quality with non-sensitive material before production use.
HanyuanWang/LiveStream-Agent-Studio.verdict: 直播電商是中文圈剛需場景，垂直 agent 工作台的定位切得準。不過帳號八年來只有這一個 repo、8 天 423 星、日均 52.9 星，對這麼垂直的 B 端工具來說成長偏快，可能有社群宣發推動；內容本身看起來是實的。

Awaker-OTE/readingspace-mn.what: MarginNote 4 的閱讀工作流插件，在文件選區、摘錄和腦圖卡片旁提供 AI 解釋、問答、朗讀、瀏覽器查資料等入口。支援把摘錄或卡片推送到本機 Obsidian，也可依範圍匯出、匯入或同步插件設定。README 提供七種語言版本。
Awaker-OTE/readingspace-mn.what_en: A reading-workflow plugin for MarginNote 4 that attaches AI explanation, Q&A, text-to-speech, and in-app web lookup directly to text selections, excerpts, and mind-map cards. It can also push excerpts or cards into a local Obsidian vault, and supports scoped export, import, and manual sync of plugin settings.
Awaker-OTE/readingspace-mn.verdict: 17 天 157 星、vel 9.2 是本榜最快，但帳號才半年、1 follower，衝這麼快多半靠 MarginNote 中文社群擴散。內容本身是真的插件，Obsidian 只是它的匯出目標之一，掛在 Obsidian 榜算擦邊但不算亂掛。

NimaChu/my-wiki.what: 本地優先的知識管理專案，讓 AI Agent 負責知識的完整生命週期：保存原始資料、提取正文、蒸餾概念、建立證據鏈接、回答問題，並以網頁呈現可探索的知識圖譜。主體提供 CLI 與視覺化介面，另附一個可單獨安裝到 Codex、Claude Code 等客戶端的輕量 Skill。知識以 Markdown 與原始檔案存在本地資料夾。
NimaChu/my-wiki.what_en: A local-first knowledge-management project where an AI agent handles the full knowledge lifecycle: saving source material, extracting readable text, distilling atomic concepts, building evidence links, answering questions, and rendering everything as an explorable knowledge graph in a web UI. The main project ships a CLI and dashboard, plus an optional lightweight skill installable into Codex, Claude Code, and similar clients. Knowledge lives as Markdown and raw files in a local folder.
NimaChu/my-wiki.verdict: README 唯一一次提到 Obsidian 是說「不需要 Obsidian」——它是 Obsidian 的替代品而非生態成員，掛進 Obsidian 分類純屬關鍵字誤中。專案本身看起來有實作，但上這個榜是分類錯誤。

KIRVO-REPORTING/video-to-notes.what: 本地優先的 CLI 工具兼 Codex skill，把 YouTube、Bilibili、TED 等 yt-dlp 支援的影片連結轉成逐字稿、帶時間戳的 AI 摘要與可搜尋的 HTML 報告。優先使用影片自帶字幕，沒有合適字幕時才用本地 Whisper 轉寫，並可選擇匯出到 Notion 或 Obsidian 知識庫。
KIRVO-REPORTING/video-to-notes.what_en: A local-first CLI and Codex skill that turns YouTube, Bilibili, TED, and other yt-dlp-supported video links into transcripts, timestamped AI summaries, and searchable HTML reports, with optional export to Notion or Obsidian. It prefers the video's own captions and falls back to local Whisper transcription only when no usable captions exist, keeping clickable timestamps back to the source.
KIRVO-REPORTING/video-to-notes.verdict: 「影片餵給 agent 變筆記」是本週明顯的一波題材（跟 lecture-to-notes 高度同構），它做得中規中矩、有網站有 demo。內容是實的，但上榜吃的是這波 agent-skill 筆記管線的順風。

AndrewRao114/vault-activity-heatmap.what: Obsidian 插件，把 vault 的編輯活動畫成 GitHub 風格的貢獻熱力圖，支援桌面、iOS 與 Android 跨裝置。點擊某一天可回顧當天改了什麼、計畫了什麼，另含每日任務、編輯時間線、AI 週/月摘要與面板主題設定。
AndrewRao114/vault-activity-heatmap.what_en: An Obsidian plugin that renders your vault's editing activity as a GitHub-style contribution heatmap across desktop, iOS, and Android. Clicking a day shows what changed and what was planned that day, and the plugin also includes daily tasks, edit timelines, AI weekly/monthly summaries, and panel-only themes.
AndrewRao114/vault-activity-heatmap.verdict: 帳號只有這一個 repo，但 49 followers、README 完整有截圖章節，是標準的 Obsidian 插件首發衝榜——熱力圖是社群長青需求，加上跨裝置與 AI 摘要兩個賣點。看起來是正常的新插件。

drpwchen/lecture-to-notes.what: 把課程或會議錄影轉成有投影片配圖的結構化筆記，並生成一個同步 HTML 檢視器：影片、帶時間戳的逐字稿與整理後的摘要在同一頁，影片播放時會標亮對應筆記，點筆記時間戳可跳轉影片。昂貴的處理階段（Whisper 轉寫、抽幀、OCR、視覺模型判讀投影片）全部在本地 GPU 執行，LLM 只在最後用來成文。同時提供 Claude Code skill 與純 CLI 兩種用法。
drpwchen/lecture-to-notes.what_en: Turns lecture or conference recordings into structured, slide-illustrated notes plus a synced HTML viewer where the video, timestamped transcript, and curated summary share one page — the video highlights the matching note as it plays, and clicking a note timestamp seeks the video. All expensive stages (Whisper ASR, frame extraction, OCR, vision-model slide analysis) run locally on your GPU; an LLM writes prose only at the end from evidence the pipeline assembled. Available as both a Claude Code skill and a plain CLI.
drpwchen/lecture-to-notes.verdict: 同一作者本週兩席，兩個 repo 都是「本地管線＋LLM 只做最後一步」的同一套哲學，README 寫得很有說服力（強調 traceability 而非 summarize）。醫師背景做筆記工具，內容扎實，28 天破百星節奏健康。

drpwchen/textbook-to-note.what: 把自己的 PDF 教科書轉成可被 AI 檢索的知識庫，並產出附完整引用、含圖片的結構化筆記。本地優先的管線，重活（OCR、抽圖、建索引）幾乎不花 LLM token，只把前沿模型留給最後的筆記合成。提供繁體中文 README。
drpwchen/textbook-to-note.what_en: Turns your own PDF textbooks into an AI-searchable knowledge base and structured, fully-cited notes with figures included. The local-first pipeline spends almost no LLM tokens on the heavy lifting (OCR, figure extraction, indexing) and reserves the frontier model solely for synthesizing the final note. A Traditional Chinese README is provided.
drpwchen/textbook-to-note.verdict: 跟 lecture-to-notes 同作者、同哲學的姊妹作，兩個一起上榜互相帶流量。動機段（醫學院筆記狂魔管理數千筆記）真誠可信，token-frugal 的設計取捨也講得清楚。

armourinfosec/Enterprise-Windows-Infrast.what: 以 Obsidian vault 形式發布的四個月實驗導向課程，涵蓋 Windows Server 管理與防禦加固：作業系統與命令列、Active Directory、Group Policy、DNS、DHCP、檔案與網頁服務、遠端存取、備份、監控，以及紫隊演練。由資安培訓機構 Armour Infosec 發布。
armourinfosec/Enterprise-Windows-Infrast.what_en: A four-month, lab-driven curriculum published as an Obsidian vault, covering Windows Server administration and defensive hardening: the OS and command line, Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, file and web services, remote access, backup, monitoring, and purple-team practice. Published by the security training organization Armour Infosec.
armourinfosec/Enterprise-Windows-Infrast.verdict: 同一機構本週三席、三個 repo 是同一模板的課程 vault 同期發布，明顯是一波有組織的內容發布＋學員/社群集中按星。內容本身不是垃圾（真的課綱），但三席同上是機構推廣行為而非三個獨立熱點。

armourinfosec/Linux-Administration-and-S.what: 四個月的實驗導向 Linux 管理與伺服器加固課程，雙發行版並行（CentOS Stream 10 與 Debian 12），共 29 個模組、20 個實驗、10 個企業專案，對齊 RHCSA/LFCS 認證。內容從命令列、使用者權限、套件與儲存、網路、自動化，到 DNS、DHCP、Apache、Samba、NFS、LDAP 等基礎服務。
armourinfosec/Linux-Administration-and-S.what_en: A four-month, lab-driven Linux administration and server-hardening curriculum taught in parallel on two distros (CentOS Stream 10 and Debian 12), with 29 modules, 20 labs, and 10 enterprise projects aligned to the RHCSA and LFCS certifications. Coverage runs from the command line, users and permissions, packages and storage, networking, and automation up through infrastructure services like DNS, DHCP, Apache, Samba, NFS, and LDAP.
armourinfosec/Linux-Administration-and-S.verdict: keyword_present 是 false——「obsidian」沒出現在名稱、描述、README、topics 任何地方，純粹因為同機構其他 repo 的關聯被撈進 Obsidian 分類。同時也是 armourinfosec 三席之一。分類上它不該在這個榜。

armourinfosec/Secure-PHP-Development.what: 一個月的實驗導向安全 PHP 開發課程筆記，從現代 PHP 8.2/8.3 語言基礎、OOP、資料庫與 REST API，到對映 OWASP 的 PHP 漏洞目錄，採「先攻擊再修復」的實驗形式，共 31 個模組。以 CC BY 4.0 授權發布。
armourinfosec/Secure-PHP-Development.what_en: A one-month, lab-driven course on secure PHP development, published as study notes under CC BY 4.0. It runs from modern PHP 8.2/8.3 fundamentals, OOP, databases, and REST APIs to a full OWASP-mapped catalogue of PHP vulnerabilities taught as exploit-then-fix labs, across 31 modules.
armourinfosec/Secure-PHP-Development.verdict: armourinfosec 三席之一，同模板課程 vault 的同期批量發布。單看內容是正經課綱，但它上榜靠的是機構這波集中推廣，不是獨立走紅。

bepitulaz/obsidian-multivault-mcp.what: 一個 MCP server，讓 Claude 讀寫放在 VPS 上的 Obsidian vault，單一部署即可服務多個 vault 與多個使用者。HTTP 模式下所有人共用同一個 connector URL，靠各自的登入密語路由到自己的私有 vault；stdio 模式則由 Claude Desktop 啟動時指定 vault 路徑。
bepitulaz/obsidian-multivault-mcp.what_en: An MCP server that gives Claude read/write access to Obsidian vaults hosted on a VPS, serving multiple vaults and multiple users from a single deployment. In HTTP mode everyone shares one connector URL and each user's login passphrase routes them to their own private vault; in stdio mode each Claude Desktop instance specifies its vault path at launch.
bepitulaz/obsidian-multivault-mcp.verdict: Obsidian MCP server 已經很多，這個的差異點是多人多 vault 的 VPS 部署，切到一個別人沒做的縫。作者是 15 年老帳號、268 followers 的資深開發者，量級不大但是真東西。

ThinkOffApp/CarWatch.what: 在車上裝一台 Raspberry Pi 5，本地執行 35B 參數的語言模型，讓車輛以 agent 身分加入 GroupMind 聊天室，回報出發、抵達、行程摘要，車輛遭碰撞時傳送行車記錄器片段。支援在駕駛座用語音提問，由車內喇叭回答，包括查詢胎壓警示與車主手冊內容，全程可離線運作。
ThinkOffApp/CarWatch.what_en: CarWatch puts a Raspberry Pi 5 in your car running a 35B-parameter language model locally, letting the vehicle join GroupMind chat rooms as an agent that reports departures, arrivals, trip summaries, and sends dashcam clips when something hits the car. Drivers can ask questions by voice from the driver's seat and get answers through the car's speakers — including tyre-pressure warnings and owner's-manual lookups — entirely offline.
ThinkOffApp/CarWatch.verdict: 點子本身有趣也有 demo 影片，但它跟 Home Assistant 幾乎無關——README 通篇講的是自家的 GroupMind 聊天室，home-assistant 只是掛在 topics 上蹭分類。帳號不到一年、是自家產品線（CodeWatch 的兄弟作）的行銷延伸。

ygelfand/echolocal.what: 用 Go 重寫的韌體服務，把已解鎖（TWRP）的第二代 Amazon Echo Dot 改造成完全本地的 Home Assistant 語音衛星，不經 Amazon 雲端。它實作 ESPHome 原生 API，Home Assistant 會像發現一般 ESPHome 裝置一樣自動接入；支援裝置端喚醒詞（openWakeWord／microWakeWord）、LED 燈環動畫、喇叭播放等功能。
ygelfand/echolocal.what_en: A pure-Go replacement for Amazon's services that turns an unlocked (TWRP) 2nd-gen Echo Dot into a fully local Home Assistant voice satellite — no Amazon, no cloud. It speaks the ESPHome native API so Home Assistant discovers it like any ESPHome device, with 100% on-device wake words (openWakeWord/microWakeWord), LED ring animations, and speaker playback.
ygelfand/echolocal.verdict: 把亞馬遜停止支援的舊硬體救回來變 HA 語音衛星，正中自架社群「去雲端化」的核心情緒，加上技術門檻（重寫整套服務、講 ESPHome 協議）確實硬。老帳號、有授權、有配套整合，是本週榜上最扎實的一件。

Ali-Marandi/SmartHome-Automation.what: 名為 Horizon 的 Windows 桌面智慧家庭控制中心，主打本地優先，以 Tauri（TypeScript + Rust）打造。支援連接 Home Assistant、本地 MQTT 加密連線、透過既有 Zigbee2MQTT 閘道器發現與控制 Zigbee 裝置，並內建可解釋的本地用電量預測；不需雲端帳號即可跑示範工作區。
Ali-Marandi/SmartHome-Automation.what_en: Horizon is a local-first Windows desktop control center for smart homes, built with Tauri (TypeScript + Rust). It connects to Home Assistant, supports secure local MQTT sessions, discovers and controls Zigbee devices through an existing Zigbee2MQTT gateway, and includes explainable local energy forecasting; the demo workspace requires no cloud account.
Ali-Marandi/SmartHome-Automation.verdict: 看起來是真的做了東西，但幾個訊號怪：沒有 LICENSE、repo 名是泛用的 SmartHome-Automation 而產品叫 Horizon、README 是行銷腔的「三分鐘體驗」。帳號夠老（2017）不像詐騙，比較像認真但包裝過頭的個人專案，先給 real 觀察。

fabiovit/casa-dashboard.what: Home Assistant 的完整 app 風格儀表板，不依賴傳統 Lovelace 卡片，以動態房間架構適應不同格局的住家。支援深淺色主題、可設定的實體、響應式設計，透過 HACS 安裝，README 提供英文與義大利文雙語。
fabiovit/casa-dashboard.what_en: A complete app-like dashboard for Home Assistant that adapts to different homes through a dynamic room architecture, without relying on traditional Lovelace cards. It offers dark and light themes, configurable entities, and responsive design, installable via HACS, with documentation in English and Italian.
fabiovit/casa-dashboard.verdict: HA 儀表板美化是常青需求，v4.x 的成熟度和實際截圖讓它有說服力。作者無名（3 followers）純靠作品上榜，量不大但真。

FezVrasta/ha-rbac.what: 為 Home Assistant 補上角色權限控制（RBAC）的整合。Home Assistant 原生只分管理員和一般使用者，一般使用者仍看得到所有裝置；這個專案讓你定義角色，決定每個人（訪客、小孩，甚至 AI agent）能看到和操作哪些實體與儀表板。
FezVrasta/ha-rbac.what_en: An integration that adds role-based access control to Home Assistant. Stock Home Assistant only distinguishes administrators from everyone else, and "everyone else" still sees every camera, lock, and sensor; this project lets you define roles that determine exactly which entities and dashboards each person — guest, kid, or even an AI agent — can see and use.
FezVrasta/ha-rbac.verdict: RBAC 是 HA 社群喊了多年的官方缺口，7 天 46 星、日速 6.6 是本榜最快。作者 FezVrasta（popper.js 作者，2157 followers）的知名度有助推，但題目本身就打在痛點上，內容是真的。

sionetta/wm_animated_ha_card.what: Home Assistant 的洗衣機動畫 Lovelace 卡片，讓接在智慧插座上的傳統洗衣機在儀表板上顯示為動態圖示：洗程進行時滾筒翻轉、門框藍弧旋轉、顯示經過時間與功率。動畫全用 CSS/SVG 實作，無外部資源，支援 prefers-reduced-motion，介面有英俄德法四種語言。
sionetta/wm_animated_ha_card.what_en: An animated Lovelace card for Home Assistant that turns a dumb washing machine on a smart plug into a live dashboard widget: while a cycle runs, laundry tumbles behind the glass, arcs spin around the door, and the display shows elapsed time and power draw. All animation is pure CSS/SVG with no external assets, it respects prefers-reduced-motion, and the UI ships in English, Russian, German, and French.
sionetta/wm_animated_ha_card.verdict: 單一功能的小而美卡片，動畫細節做得討喜，在 HA 社群這類「儀表板炫耀文」傳播力強。帳號 2014 年開卻只有這一個 repo，像是老潛水員的第一個作品，內容本身無虞。

j0sp0r/m3-cards.what: 以 Material 3 設計語言打造的 Home Assistant Lovelace 卡片集，單一 bundle 註冊 29 張卡片，涵蓋能源、功率、成本等類別。以 TypeScript + Lit 原生開發，不依賴 button-card、card-mod 等常見前置套件，目前為 beta，設定選項仍可能變動。
j0sp0r/m3-cards.what_en: A set of 29 Material 3–inspired Lovelace cards for Home Assistant, registered from a single bundle and covering categories like energy, power, and cost. Built natively with TypeScript and Lit, with no dependency on button-card, card-mod, or similar helper components; currently in beta, so configuration options may still change.
j0sp0r/m3-cards.verdict: 「不用 card-mod 全家桶」正好打中 HA 玩家維護儀表板的長期痛點，29 張卡的工作量看得出來是真做。還在 beta、星數不高，屬於穩健起步。

d4vid87/weatherdesk.what: 自架氣象站儀表板，為區網內的壁掛平板設計，支援 WeatherFlow Tempest、Ecowitt、Ambient Weather、Davis、AcuRite 等站台協議，沒有氣象站也能以指定地點的預報運作。純 Vanilla JS 與原生 ES modules，無建置步驟、無框架、無後端，所有請求由瀏覽器直連免費公開 API；雷達圖來自作者自製的 NEXRAD 檢視器 HookEcho。
d4vid87/weatherdesk.what_en: A self-hosted weather dashboard built for a wall tablet on the LAN, supporting personal weather stations like WeatherFlow Tempest, Ecowitt, Ambient Weather, Davis, and AcuRite — or running on a location forecast with no station at all. It's vanilla JS with native ES modules: no build step, no framework, no backend, with every call going browser-direct to free public APIs; radar comes from HookEcho, the author's own NEXRAD viewer.
d4vid87/weatherdesk.verdict: 「零建置零後端」的極簡技術路線加上廣泛的氣象站支援，在自架圈有明確受眾。帳號不到一年、followers 少，但 README 具體、有自製雷達引擎，是新人真作品。

ygelfand/echolocal-hacs.what: EchoLocal 韌體的 Home Assistant 配套整合（選裝）。EchoLocal 本身透過 ESPHome API 即可被 Home Assistant 接入，這個整合額外提供裝置專屬的自訂卡片（含設定與控制）、側邊欄儀表板集中管理所有裝置，以及 ESPHome 協議無法表達的額外功能。
ygelfand/echolocal-hacs.what_en: An optional Home Assistant companion integration for the EchoLocal firmware. EchoLocal is already adopted by Home Assistant through the ESPHome API on its own; this integration adds a custom device card with settings and controls, an optional sidebar dashboard for all attached devices, and extra functionality the ESPHome protocol can't express.
ygelfand/echolocal-hacs.verdict: 同帳號本週佔兩席，這席是主專案 echolocal 的配套，星數明顯是跟著主專案連動上來的。內容本身是真的，但獨立上榜價值不高。

denysdovhan/ha-ukr-hmc.what: 把烏克蘭國家水文氣象中心（meteo.gov.ua）的天氣、輻射與水文資料接進 Home Assistant 的自訂整合，可透過 HACS 安裝。這是獨立的社群專案，與該中心官方無關。
denysdovhan/ha-ukr-hmc.what_en: A custom Home Assistant integration that brings weather, radiation, and hydrology data from the Ukrainian Hydrometeorological Center (meteo.gov.ua) into Home Assistant, installable via HACS. It is an independent community project, not affiliated with the Center itself.
denysdovhan/ha-ukr-hmc.verdict: 內容真實但受眾極窄（烏克蘭本地資料），星數與速度都低；能見度主要來自作者 denysdovhan（spaceship-prompt 作者，3001 followers）的號召力，判定為知名度帶動。
